name: trakt-manager
description: Control your Trakt account directly from Raycast
author: thesobercoder

commands.name: search-media
commands.title: Search Media
commands.subtitle: Trakt Manager
commands.description: Search for movies and shows by title

commands.name: watchlist
commands.title: Watchlist
commands.subtitle: Trakt Manager
commands.description: Lists movies and shows that are in your watchlist

commands.name: up-next
commands.title: Up Next
commands.subtitle: Trakt Manager
commands.description: Get the list of shows that are up next

commands.name: history
commands.title: History
commands.subtitle: Trakt Manager
commands.description: Lists movies and shows that are in your history

tools.name: search-movies
tools.title: Search Movies
tools.description: Search for movies on Trakt by title and optional year to get details and traktId

tools.name: search-shows
tools.title: Search TV Shows
tools.description: Search for TV shows on Trakt by title and optional year to get details and traktId

tools.name: get-watchlist
tools.title: Get Watchlist
tools.description: Retrieve items from your Trakt watchlist or search if a specific title is in your watchlist using query

tools.name: get-up-next
tools.title: Get up Next Episodes
tools.description: Get the next unwatched episodes for TV series you are currently watching on Trakt

tools.name: get-show-progress
tools.title: Get Show Progress
tools.description: Get watching progress, completed episode counts, and season details for a TV show on Trakt

tools.name: add-to-watchlist
tools.title: Add to Watchlist
tools.description: Add a movie or TV show to your Trakt watchlist

tools.name: remove-from-watchlist
tools.title: Remove from Watchlist
tools.description: Remove a movie or TV show from your Trakt watchlist

tools.name: mark-movie-watched
tools.title: Mark Movie as Watched
tools.description: Mark a movie as watched in your Trakt history

tools.name: mark-episode-watched
tools.title: Mark Episode as Watched
tools.description: Mark a specific TV show episode as watched in your Trakt history

tools.name: mark-show-watched
tools.title: Mark Show as Watched
tools.description: Mark an entire TV show (all seasons and episodes) as watched in your Trakt history

tools.name: rate-media
tools.title: Rate Media
tools.description: Rate a movie, TV show, or episode on Trakt with a score from 1 to 10

tools.name: get-history
tools.title: Get Watch History
tools.description: Definitively check whether and when a movie or show was watched, or browse recent Trakt watch history

tools.name: remove-from-history
tools.title: Remove from History
tools.description: Remove a movie, TV show, or episode from your Trakt watch history

tools.name: get-recommendations
tools.title: Get Recommendations
tools.description: Get personalized movie and TV show recommendations based on your Trakt habits

tools.name: get-ratings
tools.title: Get Ratings
tools.description: Get your ratings for movies, TV shows, and episodes or search your rating for a specific title

tools.name: remove-rating
tools.title: Remove Rating
tools.description: Remove your rating for a movie, TV show, or episode on Trakt

tools.name: get-season-episodes
tools.title: Get Season Episodes
tools.description: Get all episodes for a specific TV show season with titles, air dates, and overviews

tools.name: get-user-stats
tools.title: Get User Stats
tools.description: Get your lifetime Trakt viewing statistics including watch times, movies, shows, and ratings counts

tools.name: get-lists
tools.title: Get Personal Lists
tools.description: Get your Trakt personal lists, read a list's items, or check whether a title is on a list

tools.name: create-list
tools.title: Create Personal List
tools.description: Create a new personal list on your Trakt account, with optional privacy, numbering and sorting

tools.name: update-list
tools.title: Update Personal List
tools.description: Rename a Trakt personal list or change its description, privacy, numbering or sorting

tools.name: delete-list
tools.title: Delete Personal List
tools.description: Permanently delete a Trakt personal list and every item on it

tools.name: add-to-list
tools.title: Add to Personal List
tools.description: Add movies, TV shows, seasons and episodes to a Trakt personal list in a single batch

tools.name: remove-from-list
tools.title: Remove from Personal List
tools.description: Remove movies, TV shows, seasons and episodes from a Trakt personal list

title: Trakt Manager
